verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no 2FAS desktop app. Codes are generated on iOS, Android and through browser extensions. Those extensions only pair with the phone: Auth tokens must be confirmed in the mobile app, and Pass items are retrieved from the phone rather than stored on the computer. That makes them a phone-tethered companion, which is adjacent to but not the standalone desktop surface this story asks for.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile
